text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 8px; font-family: 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #0b0b0b

g.text: Amyloid and Tau Pathology in Cognitively

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 8px; font-family: 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #0b0b0b

g.text: Unimpaired Individuals With a Parental History of

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 8px; font-family: 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #0b0b0b

g.text: Alzheimer Disease

text.style: font-size: 8px; font-family: 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #0b0b0b

g.text: Female sex and a parental history

text.style: font-size: 8px; font-family: 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #0b0b0b

g.text: of Alzheimer disease (AD), especially maternal, confer

text.style: font-size: 8px; font-family: 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #0b0b0b

g.text: increased risk of AD. Associations between sex, or

text.style: font-size: 8px; font-family: 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #0b0b0b

g.text: affected AD parent's sex, and biomarkers of AD are less

text.style: font-size: 8px; font-family: 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #0b0b0b

g.text: clear. We examined whether sex or affected AD parent's

text.style: font-size: 8px; font-family: 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #0b0b0b

g.text: sex influences (1) β-amyloid (Aβ) and tau

text.style: font-size: 8px; font-family: 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #0b0b0b

g.text: burden/accumulation, (2) the association between Aβ

text.style: font-size: 8px; font-family: 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #0b0b0b

g.text: and tau burden, and (3) brain and cognitive resilience to

text.style: font-size: 8px; font-family: 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #0b0b0b

g.text: Aβ and tau burden. The sample included 243

text.style: font-size: 8px; font-family: 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #0b0b0b

g.text: participants from the Presymptomatic Evaluation of

text.style: font-size: 8px; font-family: 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #0b0b0b

g.text: Experimental or Novel Treatments for AD cohort in

text.style: font-size: 8px; font-family: 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #0b0b0b

g.text: Canada. All participants with [18F]-NAV4694 and

text.style: font-size: 8px; font-family: 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #0b0b0b

g.text: [18F]-AV1451 PET and MRI were included. We examined

text.style: font-size: 8px; font-family: 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #0b0b0b

g.text: (1) sex or affected AD parent's sex differences on

text.style: font-size: 8px; font-family: 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #0b0b0b

g.text: regional Aβ and tau burden/accumulation; (2) 2-way

text.style: font-size: 8px; font-family: 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #0b0b0b

g.text: interactions between sex, or affected AD parent's sex,

text.style: font-size: 8px; font-family: 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #0b0b0b

g.text: and Aβ on tau burden; and (3) 3-way interactions

text.style: font-size: 8px; font-family: 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #0b0b0b

g.text: between time, sex or affected AD parent's sex, and Aβ or

text.style: font-size: 8px; font-family: 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #0b0b0b

g.text: tau deposition on hippocampal volume (brain resilience)

text.style: font-size: 8px; font-family: 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #0b0b0b

g.text: and cognition (cognitive resilience) over time.

text.style: font-size: 8px; font-family: 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #0b0b0b

g.text: Participants (69.4% female) were aged 68.3 ± 5.1 years

text.style: font-size: 8px; font-family: 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #0b0b0b

g.text: at their first PET scans. All were cognitively unimpaired

text.style: font-size: 8px; font-family: 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #0b0b0b

g.text: at baseline. Longitudinal cognitive data were available

text.style: font-size: 8px; font-family: 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #0b0b0b

g.text: for 242 participants (follow-up, 6.72 ± 2.38 years),

text.style: font-size: 8px; font-family: 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #0b0b0b

g.text: including 238 (6.53 ± 2.48 years of follow-up) with MRI

text.style: font-size: 8px; font-family: 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #0b0b0b

g.text: follow-ups and 115 (4.4 ± 0.6 years of follow-up) with

text.style: font-size: 8px; font-family: 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #0b0b0b

g.text: PET follow-ups, and 71 developed mild cognitive

text.style: font-size: 8px; font-family: 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #0b0b0b

g.text: impairment. Women showed greater tau deposition

text.style: font-size: 8px; font-family: 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #0b0b0b

g.text: (standardized β = 0.13 ± 0.3) and showed a stronger

text.style: font-size: 8px; font-family: 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #0b0b0b

g.text: association between global Aβ and tau deposition than

text.style: font-size: 8px; font-family: 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #0b0b0b

g.text: men (standardized β = 0.79 ± 0.1). Individuals with an

text.style: font-size: 8px; font-family: 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #0b0b0b

g.text: affected AD father showed stronger association between

text.style: font-size: 8px; font-family: 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #0b0b0b

g.text: global Aβ and tau deposition than those with an affected

text.style: font-size: 8px; font-family: 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #0b0b0b

g.text: AD mother (standardized β = 0.65 ± 0.1). Women

text.style: font-size: 8px; font-family: 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #0b0b0b

g.text: showed less Aβ-associated hippocampal atrophy over

text.style: font-size: 8px; font-family: 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #0b0b0b

g.text: time (standardized β = 0.24 ± 0.1). Women and,

text.style: font-size: 8px; font-family: 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #0b0b0b

g.text: surprisingly, individuals with a paternal history of AD

text.style: font-size: 8px; font-family: 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #0b0b0b

g.text: seemed more vulnerable to the Aβ-related spread of tau,

text.style: font-size: 8px; font-family: 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #0b0b0b

g.text: whereas women showed greater brain resilience to Aβ.

text.style: font-size: 8px; font-family: 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #0b0b0b

g.text: Understanding sex-specific risk and resilience could

text.style: font-size: 8px; font-family: 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #0b0b0b

g.text: allow more clinical trial precision and personalization. A

text.style: font-size: 8px; font-family: 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #0b0b0b

g.text: major limitation included the reduced sample for the

text.style: font-size: 8px; font-family: 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #0b0b0b

g.text: affected AD parent's sex analyses.

g.text: Paper (title + abstract)

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 8px; font-family: 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #0b0b0b

g.text: A potential target for noninvasive

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 8px; font-family: 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #0b0b0b

g.text: neuromodulation of PTSD symptoms derived from

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 8px; font-family: 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #0b0b0b

g.text: focal brain lesions in veterans

text.style: font-size: 8px; font-family: 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #0b0b0b

g.text: Neuromodulation

text.style: font-size: 8px; font-family: 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #0b0b0b

g.text: trials for the treatment of posttraumatic stress disorder

text.style: font-size: 8px; font-family: 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #0b0b0b

g.text: (PTSD) have yielded mixed results, and the optimal

text.style: font-size: 8px; font-family: 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #0b0b0b

g.text: neuroanatomical target remains unclear. Here we

text.style: font-size: 8px; font-family: 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #0b0b0b

g.text: analyzed three datasets to study brain circuitry causally

text.style: font-size: 8px; font-family: 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #0b0b0b

g.text: linked to PTSD in military veterans. In veterans with

text.style: font-size: 8px; font-family: 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #0b0b0b

g.text: penetrating traumatic brain injury, lesion locations that

text.style: font-size: 8px; font-family: 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #0b0b0b

g.text: reduced probability of PTSD were preferentially

text.style: font-size: 8px; font-family: 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #0b0b0b

g.text: connected to a circuit including the medial prefrontal

text.style: font-size: 8px; font-family: 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #0b0b0b

g.text: cortex, amygdala and anterolateral temporal lobe. In

text.style: font-size: 8px; font-family: 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #0b0b0b

g.text: veterans without lesions, PTSD was specifically

text.style: font-size: 8px; font-family: 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #0b0b0b

g.text: associated with increased connectivity within this circuit.

text.style: font-size: 8px; font-family: 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #0b0b0b

g.text: Reduced functional connectivity within this circuit after

text.style: font-size: 8px; font-family: 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #0b0b0b

g.text: transcranial magnetic stimulation correlated with

text.style: font-size: 8px; font-family: 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #0b0b0b

g.text: symptom reduction, even though the circuit was not

text.style: font-size: 8px; font-family: 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #0b0b0b

g.text: directly targeted. This lesion-based ‘PTSD circuit' may

text.style: font-size: 8px; font-family: 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #0b0b0b

g.text: serve as a target for clinical trials of neuromodulation in

text.style: font-size: 8px; font-family: 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #0b0b0b

g.text: veterans with PTSD.
